secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co). Aliased to VITE_SUPABASE_URL at runtime for the client.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. Aliased to VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY at runtime for the client.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key, used server-side only (process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in client.server.ts).
